_readme: Every LOINC / SNOMED CT code used under packages/*/src/fhir must appear here.
status 'approved'   -> a named person recorded what the code officially means and
confirmed it matches what the mapper sends. Passes the gate.
status 'rejected'   -> the code does not mean what the mapper sends. Fails the gate.
status 'unreviewed' -> nobody has checked. Fails the gate.
ALL 72 CODES WERE SIGNED OFF IN A SINGLE ACTION ON 2026-07-26 by the reviewer named
in each entry. That is recorded plainly because the gate exists to make approval
cost a lookup, and a bulk sign-off is a different act from 72 individual ones.
Four entries carry an 'open_question' field. They are approved AND the question is
unresolved; approving did not answer it. Read those before relying on the code.
The 38 LOINC LA* answer codes and the genomic observation codes were approved on
the strength of HL7 Genomics Reporting IG provenance, not individual verification.

77195-6.reason: CAVI is a dimensionless ratio with a normal value near 8. Sending vascular_age 45 under this code reads as CAVI 45, which is clinically alarming and dimensionally wrong (the mapper also tags it UCUM 'a', years).
77195-6.suggested: No LOINC concept for 'vascular age' was found. Emit a vendor-local code, or omit, until a clinical reviewer identifies a correct one.
77195-6.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26 — no longer emitted by any connector

248263006.reason: Efficiency and duration are different quantities. efficiency 95 is published as 95 units of sleep duration, with no unit attached. The display string 'Sleep efficiency' is invented and does not belong to this concept.
248263006.suggested: Use a vendor-local code with unit '%' until a reviewer identifies a standard concept for sleep efficiency.
248263006.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26 — no longer emitted by any connector

60842-2.official_name: Oxygen consumption (VO2), property VRat, example unit mL/min
60842-2.reason: This is absolute VO2, not weight-indexed. The mapper sends mL/min/kg under it. provider-google-health already uses the correct weight-indexed code for the same measurement, so the two connectors disagree.
60842-2.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26 — no longer emitted by any connector

41979-6.official_name: Calories burned in 24 hour, calculated (example unit kcal/(24.h))
41979-6.used_for: Oura per-workout calories, and separately a daily figure
41979-6.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26
41979-6.open_question: Retired from 'rejected' at sign-off. The misuse that caused the rejection (a single workout's calories under a 24-hour code) is fixed: workouts now use 41981-2, and 41979-6 appears only on a genuine daily total with unit kcal/(24.h).

99501-9.official_name: Sex parameter for clinical use (nominal scale, bound to answer list LL6114-4)
99501-9.reason: Two problems. The concept is not 'sex assigned at birth', and it is a coded concept: the mapper sends valueString instead of valueCodeableConcept, so the receiver cannot decode it.
99501-9.suggested: 76689-9 for the labelled concept, sent as valueCodeableConcept.
99501-9.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26 — no longer emitted by any connector

103212-7.note: Sleep latency. Also check the unit: the mapper sends seconds with no unit.
103212-7.verification: Checked against tx.fhir.org (LOINC 2.82) and NLM Clinical Tables.
103212-7.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26

103213-5.note: Time in bed. Also check the unit: seconds sent with no unit.
103213-5.open_question: OPEN QUESTION, approved anyway. LOINC is internally inconsistent here: the component says duration, the property is NRat and the example unit is /h. Verified against two independent sources. We emit min because /h is dimensionally meaningless for a duration. A term-change request to Regenstrief is still outstanding.
103213-5.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26

11524-6.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26 — no longer emitted by any connector

2339-0.open_question: OPEN QUESTION, approved anyway. This is MASS concentration (mg/dL). If any deployment receives mmol/L the CODE must change to 15074-8, not just the unit — the same class of property mismatch that produced the original VO2max defect. Nobody has confirmed the source units against Google's documentation.
2339-0.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26

40443-4.note: Used for Oura lowest_heart_rate under the display 'Resting heart rate'. Confirm the two are the same concept.
40443-4.open_question: OPEN QUESTION, approved anyway. 'Heart rate --resting' is measured awake and at rest. A wearable's daily figure is typically derived from sleep or a rolling minimum, which is a different statistic. Oura's lowest_heart_rate was moved to 103222-6 for exactly this reason; this one was not.
40443-4.reviewed: Martin Etzrodt, PhD, Open Science Foundation, 2026-07-26
